question: Does GC still improve whole-request completion when prior-batch rescue/RLE no longer gates subsequent GPU submissions under bounded resources?

input.order: decreasing max length, original pair ID tie break

host.thread_accounting: 20 compute threads plus control threads share the same 20-logical-CPU cpuset; no extra core is granted to QUEUED. Record all runnable threads and affinity. Control threads also consume time.
host.rescue_schedule_for_core_2x2: same schedule(static) within each batch; batches consumed FIFO, one batch service at a time
host.aligner_object_lifetime: same existing helper behavior in all four arms; no free persistent-aligner benefit assigned only to QUEUED
host.host_slot_payload: one batch alignment_result_t array and its full offloaded traceback, owned until rescue and normal RLE finish
host.host_slot_policy: All four arms allocate identical four-slot host storage. GATED waits on each prior-batch completion; QUEUED waits only on required slot availability and final drain. No unbounded backlog.
host.host_memory: Freeze exact integer bytes before native execution from ABI and input sizes; include slot metadata, pinned bytes, RSS/peak and process limits. No claim of equal total memory to historical R2.
host.output: write by original pair ID with exactly-once readiness; final join, full output close, and child exit inside completion timer

common.implementation_identity: One common candidate binary with runtime switches for GC and host mode; unchanged alignment/collector kernel source and flags. Log source/library/kernel hashes and compiled registers. Re-run all four cells; do not reuse historical A/B timings as new cells.
common.timer: Same R2 whole-request scope including read/sort/partition, child/context startup, allocation, all CPU/GPU computation, queue copies/backpressure/drain, synchronization, output close and exit. Post-hoc validation/hash outside. No sum of pair minima.

correctness_gates_before_performance: CPU-only ownership/scheduling model: delayed consumer, full queue/backpressure, shutdown while full, output ordering, exactly-once completion and immutable snapshot lifetimes; a model is not CUDA race certification.

After an authorized native build: independent small affine DP, real collection pressure, multiple batches and slots wrapping, mixed GPU completion/capacity rescue, late final rescue and empty final queue.
Every run must pass optimal-score and full-CIGAR checks; collector/chain failure, missing output or untracked resource excess disqualifies it. Never count failed elapsed time as throughput.
diagnostic_event_requirements: Host CLOCK_MONOTONIC: batch submit, D2H enqueue/complete/visible, snapshot begin/end, queue enqueue/dequeue/start/end, slot acquire/release and blocked-wait begin/end, rescue and normal RLE per pair, final drain/output close/child exit.
Device timestamps and CUDA correlation/events: alignment start/end, relevant copy/pack intervals and status export; bridge clocks only using an explicit supported correlation record.
Queue high-water, blocked time, allocated bytes and all live buffer owners. Failure reason/ID and input order. GC call/closure trace only in separate diagnostics.

minimal_native_campaign_after_authorizat.qualification_diagnostics: one complete exact diagnostic job per arm after correctness gates (4); new traces are separate from performance
minimal_native_campaign_after_authorizat.primary_performance: 4 Williams-balanced blocks, one fresh process per arm per block (16 full requests), at least two temporal sessions; no profiling/detailed trace
minimal_native_campaign_after_authorizat.inference_scope: n=4 per arm is a bounded repeatability check; report every block and session, no broad significance/generalization claim
minimal_native_campaign_after_authorizat.GPU_concurrency: single exclusive RTX 4060 Ti campaign; inspect shared execution lock, actual bench/compiler/profiler processes and other work before launch. Never overlap with MAIN/RCC/SCOUT or other GPU jobs.

estimands.interaction: (T_A - T_B) - (T_C - T_D); a factorial interaction, not an additive decomposition into pure collector and pure rescue instruction times
estimands.rescue_and_feasibility: arena failure count/IDs and GPU-completed set remain separate from whole-request completion

strong_simple_alternative.reason: Observed rescue work is imbalanced across static OpenMP assignments.
strong_simple_alternative.followup_if_residual_GC_claim_is_pursued: Before a broad superiority claim, compare GC OFF/ON with dynamic(1) rescue scheduling in the selected bounded pipeline using the same four compute threads and resources. Change both GC arms equally; freeze before measurement. This is a separate 2-arm qualification, not silently mixed into the core 2x2.

decision_rules: If C closes the whole-request gap to D within repeat/session variation, the historical 13.5% is not evidence of a pipeline-independent GC speed advantage; preserve the capacity/rescue observation.
If D consistently beats C under identical bounded resources and exactness, GC retains conditional end-to-end value after queue decoupling; still do not call it pure GC instruction speedup.
If QUEUED cannot progress because safe slots/backpressure dominate or resource usage rises materially, report that cost and keep the bounded GATED comparison.
Do not implement a shared GPU pool unless same-clock failure/root-closure/donor-space evidence and a genuine difference from generic allocation are established.
remaining_pre_native_freeze: exact host-slot ABI byte formula and budgets
authorization: This audit authorizes no GPU/build/install/remote/paid/upload/submission action. Those are future gates, not actions taken.

CPU_abstract_ownership_model.scope: No real pointers, memory-model proof, CUDA execution or performance

raw_replay_access: Original raw files were verified during the first audit and became unavailable before final rerun. Restore to a separate permitted copy and verify hashes before future replay. No restore/download performed.
